subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should this remain the canonical tracker for Control UI transcript triage and multi-session delivery, with project/workspace isolation and broader collaboration concerns kept in separate trackers?
rationale: The remaining work requires product decisions about durable project identity, whether selected messages are moved or copied into a branch, and whether one composer action may intentionally send to multiple sessions; source-level repair cannot safely choose those semantics.

options.title: Narrow this tracker to chat triage and routing
options.body: Keep project-tree navigation, selected-message branch/copy behavior, and explicit multi-session delivery here while linking broader workspace and isolation work elsewhere.

options.title: Merge it into a broader project tracker
options.body: Move the remaining UI requirements under a single project-domain proposal if maintainers want projects to become a first-class runtime object.

options.title: Stop at session management
options.body: Close the broader direction after documenting that pinning, archiving, naming, and parallel sessions are the intended supported model.

recommendation.title: Narrow this tracker to chat triage and routing
recommendation.body: Keep project-tree navigation, selected-message branch/copy behavior, and explicit multi-session delivery here while linking broader workspace and isolation work elsewhere.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged session-management work and the existing issue review tie this person most directly to the current feature boundary.
